candidate.title: CLaP
candidate.scope: The middle CLaP row of the assigned Illumina schematic: cell labeling via photobleaching in confluent culture, followed by single-cell isolation and transcript sequencing. The left Single cell → poly(A)-RNA icon summarizes the biological readout; it is not a physical transfer into the confluent culture. The independent PAIR and CytoSeq rows are neighboring workflows, not alternative CLaP workflows. The clipped molecular illustrations at the right explain reagents; the B4F structure is not a separate transformation and no complete chemical structure is inferred from its cropped drawing. The terminal caption is separated at cell, library and data boundaries only to identify the material carrier and its association, as resolved by the supplied primary paper. This is a schematic architecture, not a complete execution protocol or a claim that every CLaP application uses the depicted sequencing route.
